title: control key does not work when keyboard manager is active
summary: Control shortcuts reportedly stop working after using a Keyboard Manager shortcut remap.

judgment.rationale: The report gives an intermittent scenario, but the triggering event and current-build behavior need isolation.
evidence: On 0.99.1 the reporter maps Ctrl+Left to Home and says after some Edge use Ctrl+A/C/V behave as if Ctrl is not pressed.
Current KeyboardManager::HandleKeyboardHookEvent routes events through single-key, app-specific and OS-level shortcut handlers; the routing alone does not establish a modifier-state defect.
judgment.recommended_action: Reproduce using the reported mapping and compare physical and logical Ctrl state before and after the failure.

fix_assessment.rationale: A targeted modifier-handling correction may be applicable after reproducing the current failing sequence.

proposed_fixes.title: Investigate Ctrl shortcut state after remapping
proposed_fixes.root_cause: A remap-related modifier state or suppression issue is possible but the triggering event is unverified.
plan: Reproduce the Ctrl+Left to Home mapping with Edge and control applications.
Record physical and logical key transitions and isolate any stale state or suppressed event.
Correct the demonstrated state transition without disturbing remapped and ordinary Ctrl combinations.
Add regression tests for the triggering sequence, key release and unrelated shortcuts.
verification: The mapped shortcut works and ordinary Ctrl shortcuts continue working after the reproduced sequence.
Other modifier combinations and application-specific remaps remain correct.

confidence.rationale: The report is intermittent and neither the current trigger nor cause is established.

issue_context.summary: Control shortcuts reportedly stop working after using a Keyboard Manager shortcut remap.
known_information: On 0.99.1 the reporter maps Ctrl+Left to Home and says after some Edge use Ctrl+A/C/V behave as if Ctrl is not pressed.
The issue does not identify a deterministic trigger or provide a diagnostic ZIP.
inferences: A stale or suppressed modifier state is possible but unproven.
initial_investigation: Inspected src/modules/keyboardmanager/KeyboardManagerEngineLibrary/KeyboardManager.cpp: the keyboard hook routes input through multiple remap handlers in priority order.

Reviewed the complete thread and linked issue bodies #47985 (Copy as Path shortcut interrupted) and #48003 (intermittent text shortcuts); neither establishes a covering fix or identical cause. An open-PR title search for Keyboard Manager Ctrl found no match.
issue_context.analysis: Intermittent modifier symptoms warrant a bounded maintainer reproduction before choosing an implementation.

information_gaps.information: The exact event sequence and keyboard state when Ctrl shortcuts stop working on a current build.
information_gaps.why_needed: Distinguishes remap state, application focus and other causes.
information_gaps.how_to_collect: Exercise the stated remap and compare Ctrl key events and shortcuts before and after failure.

reproduce.title: Investigate Ctrl shortcut state after remapping
reproduce.version_requirement: Use the current PowerToys release and compare with 0.99.1 if practical.
prerequisites: Use a Windows test environment and back up existing Keyboard Manager mappings.
setup: Enable Keyboard Manager and map Ctrl+Left to Home. Open Edge and a standard text editor.
steps: 1. Confirm Ctrl+Left performs Home and Ctrl+A/C/V work normally in Edge and the editor.
2. Use the remap and ordinary shortcuts repeatedly while switching focus, watching for the reported intermittent failure.
3. If it occurs, compare physical and logical Ctrl key state and keydown/up events; check another application.
4. Disable the remap and compare, preserving the triggering sequence for a focused regression test.
reproduce.expected_result: The remap works and unrelated Ctrl shortcuts continue to behave normally.
